rationale.consistency: What exists follows repo idioms (query_builder case, ghinstance prefix helper, gh interface doc comments), but the AuthConfig interface change has no accompanying mock/regen and no command-package conventions are exercised.
rationale.edge_cases: None of the required validation exists: no extension/size/regular-file checks, no duplicate/symlink detection, no GHES/token/role refusal ordering, no code-fence-aware markdown rewriting.
rationale.scope: Delivers only the thin API/config/host-prefix layer; the entire internal/attachments package, uploader, --attach flag, and wiring into six commands and the HTTP mock are absent.
rationale.readability: Clear names and helpful comments; the PRRepository comment is a little dense, and the Repository struct comment insertion breaks field alignment in an awkward way.
rationale.robustness: Nil guards on Repository accessors are fine, but no failure handling for the upload path or file validation is present because those paths were never written.
rationale.maintainability: Token-type enum and accessors are extensible, yet the bulk of the feature is missing so the pieces here are dangling scaffolding with no consumer.
